decision: disposition: needs follow-up — crude boxy primitives (edr:dreadMid, edr:tower*), overbright flat-white edr:dreadRing halo dominating the silhouette, orthogonal +X Kestrel canopy/dish/sideways engineProp/grime slab, and non-capital R=6 staging scale.
